concern: Urdu پالی (obtained/attained, past tense verb paa + li) is rendered "pai" instead of the corpus's established "paa li" (used at 33:71, 43:53 for the same verb). "pai" alone reads as an unrelated fragment (cf. pai-dar-pai) and drops the verb ending.
suggestion: Beshak us ne falaah paa li jo paak ho gaya.
